decks.notes: This Azorius Aggro deck focuses on quickly establishing a board presence and controlling the game with a mix of disruptive spells and aggressive creatures. By using cards like Founding the Third Path and Helping Hand to generate card advantage and protect your creatures, while also having access to bounce spells like Unsummon to disrupt your opponent's game plan. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with evasive threats like Abhorrent Oculus and finish the game quickly with powerful creatures like Haughty Djinn.

This deck focuses on quickly overwhelming opponents with a combination of aggressive creatures and disruptive spells, aiming to apply constant pressure while disrupting their game plan. By efficiently deploying threats and removing opposing threats, the deck seeks to gain an advantage and swiftly close out the game before the opponent can stabilize. The deck's mix of creatures and spells provides a versatile toolkit for adapting to different matchups and maintaining momentum throughout the game.

This Boros Control deck focuses on managing the board state and controlling the opponent's resources through a combination of removal spells, powerful creatures, and disruptive enchantments. By utilizing cards like Caretaker's Talent, Get Lost, and Urabrask's Forge, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while building towards a win condition with creatures like Realmbreaker and Quintorius Kand. Archangel Elspeth can provide added protection and resilience, while cards like Lightning Helix and Sunfall help to stabilize the player's life total. With a mix of aggression and control elements, the deck aims to out-value and outlast the opponent.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and disruptive spells, aiming to quickly deplete their resources and win the game before they can stabilize. By combining efficient creatures like Spiteful Hexmage and Kaito, Bane of Nightmares with spells like Nowhere to Run and Stormchaser's Talent, the deck puts pressure on the opponent while also disrupting their game plan. The mana base is designed to support the aggressive strategy with a mix of dual lands that can provide the necessary colors for casting spells.

The main concept of this Azorius Aggro deck is to flood the board with low-cost creatures and use cards like Haughty Djinn and Abhorrent Oculus to control the battlefield and overwhelm your opponent quickly. By utilizing cards like Chart a Course and Kiora, the Rising Tide, you can draw more cards and maintain card advantage. Recommission and Soul Partition provide additional ways to protect your creatures and disrupt your opponent's strategy. Overall, the deck focuses on aggressive plays and efficient use of resources to outpace the opponent and secure victory.

The main concept of this Boros Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent by quickly building a board presence and dealing damage rapidly with efficient creatures and burn spells. The deck aims to apply consistent pressure on the opponent by utilizing cards like Emberheart Challenger, Heartfire Hero, and Flowerfoot Swordmaster, supported by burst damage from cards like Burst Lightning and Lightning Helix. By maintaining a fast pace and utilizing a mix of creatures and spells, the deck seeks to close out games quickly before the opponent can effectively respond.

The main concept of this Dimir Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures like Faerie Mastermind, Spyglass Siren, and Floodpits Drowner, while disrupting their strategy with cards like Go for the Throat and Cut Down. Enduring Curiosity and Faebloom Trick provide card advantage and additional utility. The deck also includes some control elements with cards like Spell Stutter and Nowhere to Run. Overall, the goal is to apply early pressure, control the board, and finish off the opponent quickly with powerful creatures like Kaito, Bane of Nightmares.

The main focus of this deck is to overwhelm opponents with fast, aggressive creatures and direct damage spells. By maintaining a low mana curve and focusing on creatures with haste, this deck aims to consistently apply pressure to the opponent early in the game. The inclusion of burn spells like Lightning Strike and Burst Lightning allows for additional reach and removal, while cards like Monstrous Rage and Witchstalker Frenzy provide additional combat tricks and ways to buff up creatures for maximum damage output. Overall, this deck prioritizes speed and aggression to secure quick victories.

This deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with a swarm of aggressive creatures and burn spells. The key strategy is to play low-cost creatures like Manifold Mouse and Hired Claw to establish an early board presence, while using cards like Burst Lightning and Monstrous Rage to deal direct damage to the opponent's creatures or face. Innkeeper's Talent and Emberheart Challenger provide additional card advantage and power, allowing the deck to maintain pressure and close out games before the opponent can stabilize. The land base is built to ensure consistent mana for a fast and furious assault.

This Dimir Aggro deck focuses on using low-cost creatures and disruption spells to quickly overwhelm opponents and control the board. The deck includes a mix of aggressive creatures like Spyglass Siren and Floodpits Drowner, as well as removal spells like Go for the Throat and Cut Down to deal with opposing threats. Enduring Curiosity and Faebloom Trick provide card advantage and synergy with the deck's strategy. The goal is to apply pressure early and maintain board control while disrupting the opponent's strategy.

The main concept of this deck is to heavily control the battlefield using a combination of removal spells like Analyze the Pollen and Tolarian Terror, along with efficient creatures like Eddymurk Crab and Seed of Hope. The deck aims to slow down the opponent's game plan with disruption and card advantage, while building up its own resources through cards like Cache Grab and Stormchaser's Talent. By establishing board control and drawing into key pieces with cards like Sleight of Hand, this deck looks to outvalue and outlast the opponent in a war of attrition.

The main focus of this deck is to maintain control of the game by disrupting the opponent's strategy and utilizing various spells and abilities to gain an advantage. This Dimir Control deck includes cards that allow you to remove threats, counter spells, and draw cards while maintaining a solid mana base. By using cards like Hopeless Nightmare and Stormchaser's Talent, you can disrupt your opponent's plans while setting up your own win condition. Additionally, cards like Get Out and Fear of Isolation can provide additional utility and control options to help you stay ahead in the game.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive red creatures and efficient removal spells to chip away at their life total. Utilizing a combination of cheap creatures with haste like Monastery Swiftspear and Emberheart Challenger, as well as burn spells like Lightning Strike and Burst Lightning, the deck aims to close out games quickly before the opponent can stabilize. With a focus on speed and consistency, the deck aims to pressure the opponent early and maintain that pressure throughout the game.
